content.what_it_is: Fortran I/O and run-configuration unit. OUTPUT advances screen, station, and field-output clocks and dispatches STATISTICS, STATIONS, and PREVIEW in the opening routine. READ_INPUT parses input.txt or a command-line-selected file, supplies defaults or stops on required fields, configures MPI decomposition, grid/bathymetry, hot start, wavemakers and spectra, absorbing boundaries, sponge/obstacle/breakwater physics, dispersion/breaking/friction/numerics, and output flags (READ_INPUT ends L2338). STATIONS maps global station indices to the local MPI tile, buffers time/eta/u/v samples, and writes per-station streams (L2350-L2460). PREVIEW and PREVIEW_MEAN construct numbered output names and delegate instantaneous and mean/radiation-stress fields to PutFile (L2473-L2770). GetFile reads a global ASCII field on rank 0, extends edge ghost cells, gathers tile bounds and sends each haloed tile with MPI (L2782-L2880). PutFile dispatches ASCII versus binary field writers from FIELD_IO_TYPE (L2892-L2912).

verbatim_spans.text: IF(NO_UV_FILE) NO_UV_FILE = .TRUE.    ! in case you dont have u file

unresolved: U/V hot-start presence is not combined correctly: U_FILE absence sets NO_UV_FILE=.TRUE. at L428, but a present V_FILE overwrites it to .FALSE. at L446; the supposed preservation test at L447 tests that newly false value, so the comment 'in case you dont have u file' is ineffective.

ETA_LIMITER is read at L1124 and immediately tested at L1125 without any ierr branch/default; if READ_LOGICAL does not assign on a missing key and the GLOBAL value is not initialized elsewhere, the branch uses an undefined or stale value.

The absorbing DATA phase read jumps from L1275 to label 991 at L1279 on EOF, bypassing CLOSE(1) at L1277; the no-phase fallback therefore leaves unit 1 open while successful phase input sets INPUT_PHASE at L1278.

WAVE_DATA_TYPE is read at L1228 without checking ierr, then sliced at L1255; likewise WidthWaveMaker and R/A sponge-wavemaker reads at L1249-L1252 have no absence handling. Missing keys can therefore propagate undefined/stale configuration into branch selection and sponge calculations unless GLOBAL or INPUT_READ supplies undocumented initialization.

ROLLER is consulted at L1677 to force VISCOSITY_BREAKING before ROLLER_EFFECT is read and defaulted at L1868-L1871. Thus the forcing decision uses the pre-input value and is not revisited after the actual ROLLER input is known.
The absent-CONSTRUCTION diagnostic says 'USE HLL' at L1752, but the actual default assigned at L1753 is HLLC, so the log and active numerical flux disagree.

The mutually enabled VISCOSITY_BREAKING/WAVEMAKER_VIS path prints STOP and calls MPI_FINALIZE at L1950-L1956 but has no STOP/RETURN after finalization (L1957 continues), allowing execution to proceed after MPI has been finalized.

EtaBlowVal input is commented out at L2104, yet L2105 tests ierr left by the preceding OUT_Radiation read at L2101. Its conditional assignment is therefore controlled by an unrelated key; L2106 assigns 10.0_SP while L2108-L2109 claim '100xmax_depth' and L2113 says init.F sets that value, leaving this block internally inconsistent.

Station buffering loses and/or fabricates samples: once the condition at L2428 is false, the current sample is never inserted before L2435-L2438 flush and reset, so each overflow-triggering sample is dropped. At TIME>=TOTAL_TIME the same ELSE writes exactly StationOutputBuffer rows even when BufferCount is smaller; ZUV_Buffer was allocated at L2374-L2375 but not initialized, so unwritten tail rows can be uninitialized on the first partial flush or stale after later flushes before files close at L2451-L2457.

NumberStations is read at L2048 and used at L2049 without an ierr default; absence handling depends on undocumented prior initialization. The many output logical reads L2065-L2101 likewise overwrite the same ierr and provide no per-flag default in this routine.
